stem: An audit policy requires Aurora recovery points for 30 days and separate long-term monthly copies that remain until explicitly deleted.

choices.text: Set 30-day automated retention and create monthly manual cluster snapshots.
Set 30-day automated retention and rely on automated backups only for long-term copies.
Enable PITR with a 35-day window as the sole long-term retention mechanism.
Deploy Multi-AZ standbys and use failover topology as the retention strategy.

rationale: Automated backups cover operational retention windows, while manual snapshots provide explicit long-term copies that do not expire until deletion. Automated retention alone cannot satisfy open-ended monthly copy retention. PITR windows are bounded and do not replace indefinite snapshot retention. Multi-AZ topology improves availability but is not a backup-retention instrument.
